posts.author: Government of Jersey
posts.text:
Islanders are advised to remain indoors and avoid unnecessary travel or outdoor activity until lunchtime today, while teams continue clearing roads.

Although winds are easing, please take care if you need to travel. 

List of affected Government services: https://t.co/WZByNTWSUL

posts.author: Guernsey Airport  ✈
posts.text: We regret flights are disrupted this evening and tomorrow as the forecast weather exceeds safe operating limits. We expect to open noon Friday with flights resuming around 2pm. If you are booked to travel your airline will advise of alternative arrangements.

posts.author: States of Guernsey
posts.text: States of Guernsey customer counters will be closed on Friday morning while the worst of Storm Austen passes over the islands. This includes counters at Frossard House, Brickfield House, the Guernsey Registry, Edward T Wheadon House and the New Jetty: https://gov.gg/StormAusten
